Name Type Default Description channel ChannelType filter on qualified endpoint to narrow down the receivers. dependentEntity @@@ addition entities alnog with BO endPointID string this can be single ID as per specified type or array of IDS ass per specified types. endPointType EndpointType endPointType and endPointID togather determines set of endpoint to send the message entityObject KloEntity BO to send as message onlyRootEntity boolean if true only the root object will be in message else its child also will be in Message onlydirtyobject boolean if true builds only dirty object in message else loads the complete entity object

addDependantEntities(entity): KloEntity[] Parameters​ Name Type Description entity KloEntity The KloEntity instance to add as a dependent entity Returns​ KloEntity[] - Array of all dependent entities including the newly added one Description​ Adds a dependent entity to be included in the data message sent to endpoints. Dependent entities are additional entities that should be sent along with the main entity object. This is useful when you need to send related data that may not be directly linked but is contextually important. Example​ let endpointBean = eventContext.addEndpoint("USER001", EndpointType.USER, ChannelType.DEVICE, orderEntity); let customerEntity = await txn.loadEntityP("d_customer", customerKey); endpointBean.addDependantEntities(customerEntity); // Customer info sent along with order See​ getDependantEntities to retrieve the list of dependent entities

getDependantEntities(): KloEntity[] Returns​ KloEntity[] - Array of KloEntity instances that are configured as dependent entities Description​ Gets the list of dependent entities that have been added to this endpoint bean. Dependent entities are additional entities that will be included in the data message along with the primary entity object when the message is sent to endpoints. Example​ let endpointBean = eventContext.addEndpoint("USER001", EndpointType.USER, ChannelType.DEVICE, orderEntity); endpointBean.addDependantEntities(customerEntity); endpointBean.addDependantEntities(productEntity); let dependents = endpointBean.getDependantEntities(); console.log("Number of dependent entities:", dependents.length); See​ addDependantEntities to add dependent entities

Application url: https://<domain_Name>p6/<Landscape>/index.html Note: URL should be applied according to the server in which the Procify IDE will be set up. Please check whether the URL is accessible in your browser with a valid SSL certificate. If it is not accessible then contact the Admin team. You should have the Procify IDE Installer file (.exe). This installer will change the node modules' global installation path and if you are having any modules installed globally, please reinstall again after this installation is completed. Remove the node path which is set in the user environment variables. Path: C:\Users\< user profile >\AppData\Roaming\npm

Step 1 - Add Admin Credentials Double click the installer file (.exe) and enter the Administrator credentials to start the installation. [For Admin credentials, please contact Admin team] Step 2 - Accept License agreement Accept the license agreement and click on next. Step 3 - Select Procify IDE Setup Location Select the folder where you want to create the workspace for your procify IDE setup and click on next. NOTE: By default the destination folder will be “C:\Procify\workspace”. Please change the destination folder to any editable drive (example: D or E). Until and unless you are logged in as an administrator user, you will not be able to create or edit any files that are present in C drive. In the below image it shows the destination folder as D:\workspace\trunkqa where instead of trunkqa put a name by which you will be able to understand which server you are creating your Procify IDE setup. In case you are using this Procify IDE installer multiple times then change the destination folder accordingly. Click on Next. Step 4 - Add Server Information A new Dialog will appear asking for server information. Enter all the credential details in the required fields. The server details include the following: Credentials Credential Details Application index url This url will keep changing based on the domain and landscape you use it for. For example: https://<domain_Name>Klarion/u/c/V1/<Landscape>/fs/index.html User Id This is the Procify user credentials used to login to the application. Password This is the password used to login to the application. Fill in all the details and click on Next. Step 5 - Select Additional Task A new dialog will appear as shown in the image below, the default checkbox will be checked for “Create a desktop shortcut”. Then click on next. Note: If you do not want to create any shortcut on your desktop screen then uncheck the box and proceed. Step 6 - Install Procify IDE file After that, the “Ready to Install” page will appear. Click on install. This step will take some time to load. Kindly, wait until the process is completed. ![][image6] Step 7 - Accept the Folder Authentication Query After installation, the workspace folder will open in Visual Studio Code. Click on “Yes, I trust the author Trust folder and enable all features” to proceed to the next step. ![][image7] Now in the VS code, IDE setup will be in process. It will automatically trigger a command npm run kloServerStart. This will download all the required files and it will take some time, kindly wait till the process is complete. ![][image8] Once the above process is completed, it will automatically open the Repository. Here you checkout the Apps by selecting those apps and click on checkout. ![][image9] After clicking on the checkout it will download the App files from the server to the workspace. ![][image10] Once the apps checkout is done it will show the ‘Files Checkouted Successful‘ message. Step 8 - Accept the Folder Authentication Query Once the above process is completed, close the VS code instance. Then double click on the Procify IDE desktop shortcut and it will open your workspace folder in the VS code. If you opted not to create the Procify IDE desktop shortcut, then go to the destination folder you have provided during the start of the installation and open that folder in vs code by following the below steps: First open the workspace folder in the command prompt (In the file path, type cmd and press enter). Then type code . and enter, it will open your workspace folder in VS code. Click on “Yes, I trust the authors Trust folder and enable all features” to proceed to the next step. ![][image7]

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-15475 UI Editor: On rename of any page element, select the existing text(so that user can start typing new value directly) Tools:UI Editor No UI Editor: When renaming a page element, the existing text is selected, enabling the user to start typing the new value right away. After the rename dialog box is opened the text inside the input box is automatically selected. PROC-9723 Message Monitor - Endpoint information on popover Tools: Message monitor No On hovering over the endpoint, the details will be displayed in a popover. End point Details like Registration date, last active date ,Last transaction, device type and status will be shown. The popover functionality has been added to show the endpoint details when hovered over. PROC-15240 BOL Editor -Add validation to restrict changing the primary keys in the child flavor Tools: Bol Editor No The primary key cannot be modified in entities passed from the parent app to the child app, nor in entities created using an older flavor version. These restrictions are in place to maintain data integrity and consistency across different versions and flavors. PROC-16164 Validation while adding and saving in App Hierarchy Detail Section Tools -System Admin No App Hierarchy Detail Section added Validation. A validation is now in place to prevent creating cyclic JSON structures when assigning a parent to a flavor, ensuring no crashes occur. Additionally, if a flavor version is deleted and a new version of the same flavor is assigned immediately, it won't work. The user must save changes before adding the new version. Details: App Hierarchy
No features are developed as a part of the release in this module.

Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-15842 IFB- File size restriction on attachment upload Ui Controls- kloAttach Control No Added 2 new properties in UI editor for kloAttach control : Introduced a new property to restrict user attachments based on requirements, enhancing control. Two new properties, `maxFileSizeAttachment` and `showFileSizeRestriction`, along with their validations, have been added for all four modes in the KloAttach control. Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption doc Short Description PROC-16358 Appropriate Message to be shown if no internet connectivity KloTouch-klobo No Introduced a new banner notification that will appear when an online request fails due to network issues, informing the user of a "No Internet Connection." The banner will automatically disappear when the user navigates to a different screen. However, if the user tries to access an online screen without an internet connection, the banner will reappear. Once the internet connection is restored, the banner will be removed automatically. PROC-10397 For the screens in which Pivot modeler is used, properties used in modeler is missing in List screen KloTouch When an entity property is placed inside the report modeler's column (as a child of the report), if a control with the same name as the entity property already exists in that section then the control will be added with a different id to the report modeler. PROC-15102 Excel Download: Numeric(Decimal) Data Exported as String KloTouch Excel Download: Numeric (Decimal) Data Exported as String, so when downloading an Excel file, if any entity property has a numeric data type (such as Decimal (1), Decimal (2), Decimal (3), Integer 8, Integer 16, Integer 32), the corresponding column in the Excel file will be formatted as a number. In the `prepareXLSXFromJSON` method of `kloSectionXlsx`, if any entity property has a numeric data type (Decimal (1), Decimal (2), Decimal (3)), the respective column in the generated Excel file will be formatted as a number. PROC-10397 For the screens in which Pivot modeler is used, properties used in modeler is missing in List screen KloTouch If an entity property is added to the report modeler's column as a child of the report, and a control with the same name already exists in that section, the control will be added to the report modeler with a unique ID.

There is an ask from Google Play store to upgrade our Mobile App to latest API versions and existing App will be stopped from 1-Sep-2025. To address this there is a Mobile App update also released and it works on Klobase version 7-2-208 or higher. The new Mobile App version will be uploaded to Play store by 5-Sep-2025 ***Please make sure all the systems are upgraded to klobase version 7-2-208 or higher. Reference: https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/11926878
documents.s: Note for the App Team Developers/Managers

documents.t: Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-18584 UI Editor: Device need to be added in "Preview In" and existing needs correction No Tools - UI Editor Enhanced preview functionality by adding new device options to "Preview In" feature and corrected existing device preview settings for better responsive design testing. Status: **Tested** PROC-20605 UI Editor: Coping a existing page to a different App, changes the id of the controls copied to previous id+"_copy01" No Tools - UI Editor Fixed issue where copying pages between apps resulted in incorrect control ID naming convention. Controls now maintain proper unique IDs when copied across applications. Status: **Tested** PROC-20474 Wizard: Update through wizard is not working for child entity No Tools - UI Editor Resolved wizard update functionality for child entities. Updates to child entities through wizard interface now work correctly. Status: **Tested** PROC-19513 Primary key update should be restricted (UI editor) No Tools - UI Editor Implemented restrictions on primary key updates in UI editor to prevent data integrity issues and maintain referential consistency. Status: **Tested** PROC-21284 Please update the package.json "libphonenumber-js": "^1.12.9" to the vsix No BOL - Private Node (VS Code) Updated libphonenumber-js package to version 1.12.9 in VSIX package for improved phone number validation and formatting capabilities. Status: **Tested** PROC-19721 Feature Request – Read-Only Code Checkout for a User No BOL - Private Node (VS Code) Developers can access and analyze the application's code and structure to debug or investigate issues. However, code modifications are restricted unless the app is explicitly assigned to them. Only developers have permission to save files within the app. While referencing logic is allowed during custom development, existing workflows can be explored safely without the risk of unintended changes. Status: **Tested**

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-20598 $Variable needed to know the screen size No Tools - UI Editor Introduced screen size variables to enable responsive design capabilities. Controls can now dynamically adjust based on device screen dimensions for improved mobile experience. Status: **Tested** PROC-20499 Feature to Select Desired loading image in kloAttachment - Type: Image (PNG/JPEG) No Tools - UI Editor Enhanced kloAttachment control with customizable loading image selection. Users can now specify custom loading images for better visual feedback during image loading. Status: **Tested** PROC-20530 Grid with auto height(fit to area), empty space height should be reduced / removed in the footer(end) No KloTouch Optimized grid layout by reducing/removing empty footer space when using auto height (fit to area) setting, improving visual appearance and space utilization. Status: **Tested** PROC-19928 KloInput(Combo Box) on down arrow from keyboard suggestions items should get loaded No KloTouch Enhanced KloInput combo box to load suggestion items when down arrow key is pressed, improving keyboard navigation and accessibility. Status: **Tested**

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-18928 Transport : check should be added to confirm the klobase version in config No BOL - Transport Added version validation checks in transport configuration to ensure Klobase version compatibility during transport operations. Status: **Done - Closed** PROC-20336 VH :- Unable to add deleted values again in vhc, throwing error "Cannot read properties of null (reading '_pm')" No BOL Deleted VH entries with the same key can now be re-added, even if the key differs only by case. Status: **Tested** PROC-20067 Excel upload and download for object type and rollup status in BOL editor No BOL Implemented Excel import/export functionality for object type and rollup status configurations in BOL editor, enabling bulk data management. Status: **Tested** PROC-19104 If build is taking very long time, then it should be marked as FAILED No BOL - Flavor Build Added timeout mechanism for build processes. Builds exceeding specified time limits (e.g., 20 minutes) are now automatically marked as FAILED. Status: **Tested** PROC-20917 Bol Editor: Where used List, if no data found show it in a messageBox No BOL Editor Enhanced user experience by displaying an informative message box when "Where Used" functionality finds no references instead of showing empty tables. Status: **Tested** PROC-20748 VH Config: Adding duplicate keys(id) should be supported No BOL Enhanced Value Help configuration to allow duplicate key IDs when business requirements necessitate multiple entries with same identifier. Status: **Tested** PROC-19496 BOL Editor :- If we are creating or copying any status or config entity and navigating to any other entity it is getting removed from where we added No BOL Editor Fixed data persistence issue where newly created or copied status/config entities were lost when navigating between entities in BOL Editor. Status: **Tested** PROC-20281 Column Sort with loadAll true needs to be handled No BOL Enhanced column sorting functionality to properly handle scenarios where loadAll property is set to true, ensuring consistent data ordering. Status: **Tested** PROC-20265 Column Filter is not working based on the Key-ID No BOL, KloTouch Fixed column filtering functionality to work correctly with Key-ID based filtering, improving data search and display capabilities. Status: **Tested** PROC-20821 oData - Error Handling is not proper No BOL Improved oData error handling mechanisms to provide better error messages and graceful failure recovery for data service operations. Status: **Tested** PROC-21117 Addition of VH Config Item: Please add "KloRemarks" as key and text in base_control propertytype p_vh_id value help No BOL Added "KloRemarks" configuration item to base_control property type value help for enhanced control documentation and metadata management. Status: **Tested** PROC-17273 In app notification No BOL Implemented in-app notification system for real-time user communication and system status updates within the application interface. Status: **Tested**

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-9574 DEEP LINK / UNIVERSAL LINK: Runtime No KloTouch Implemented deep linking and universal link functionality for mobile runtime, enabling direct navigation to specific app screens from external sources.Universal Link release is only for desktop. Universal Link for apk and ipa will be handled in subsequent release. Status: **Done - Closed** PROC-9248 Side by Side view - Open & Close of right hand side section is not smooth No KloTouch Improved animation and transition effects for side-by-side view panel opening and closing operations for smoother user experience. Status: **Tested** PROC-20438 In case of any dirty object if users navigates to different screen using menu item, Dirty object popup should appear No KloTouch Enhanced data protection by implementing dirty object detection and confirmation popup when users navigate away from screens with unsaved changes. Status: **Tested** PROC-20283 Advanced search: tokens to be displayed if query parameter is set No KloTouch Enhanced advanced search functionality to display search tokens when query parameters are provided, improving search visibility and user experience. Status: **Tested**

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-20595 POC : UWL and Workflow :Timeline screen alignment in mobile view No BOL - Workflow Enhanced timeline screen layout and alignment for mobile view in Universal Work List, improving mobile user experience and readability. Status: **Tested** PROC-20594 POC : UWL and Workflow : Search Section on Desktop No BOL - Workflow Added search functionality section to desktop version of UWL for improved filtering and navigation capabilities. Status: **Tested** PROC-20593 POC : UWL and Workflow : Status Mismatch in History Tab No BOL - Workflow Resolved status inconsistency issues in History tab where mobile and desktop versions showed different status values for the same requests. Status: **Tested** PROC-20591 POC : UWL and Workflow : Column Width Adjustments No BOL - Workflow Optimized column width settings to eliminate horizontal scrolling and improve data visibility across different screen sizes. Status: **Tested** PROC-20589 POC : UWL and Workflow : Grid Column Order No BOL - Workflow Implemented column reordering functionality for UWL grid, allowing users to customize column arrangement based on their preferences. Status: **Tested** PROC-20588 POC : UWL and Workflow : Mandatory Rejection Reason No BOL - Workflow Enforced mandatory rejection reason input for workflow rejection actions, ensuring proper documentation of rejection decisions. Status: **Tested** PROC-20403 FSFM : Require the ability to pass query parameters to the UWL No BOL - Workflow Enhanced UWL to accept and process query parameters for filtered views and pre-configured search states. Status: **Tested** PROC-20075 POC : UWL and Workflow : New Actor Assignment Screen No BOL - Workflow Implemented new actor assignment interface for improved workflow task delegation and assignment management. Status: **Tested**

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-20705 Account Console :- Navigation to the app in app group's app section is not working in 36 server in DEV No Tools - Account Console Fixed navigation issue in DEV environment (server 36) where clicking on apps within app groups failed to navigate to the selected application. Status: **Tested**

Status: **Tested** PROC-19957 Landscape Editor: After changing data from Source Server Config dialog, the updated data are not reflecting in config.json file No Tools - Other Fixed data synchronization issue in Landscape Editor where changes made through Source Server Config dialog were not properly saved to config.json file. Status: **Tested** PROC-19726 Msg monitoring flavor should not extend adm No Tools - Other Refactored message monitoring flavor architecture to remove dependency on ADM extension, improving modularity and reducing coupling. Status: Tested

Module: BOL Editor / Dev Tools Below are the new features, improvements, and bug fixes delivered in this release for BOL Editor and Dev Tools. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-25909 BOL Editor: Auto Number Behaviour Is Not Consistent Fixed an inconsistency in the Auto Number field where generated numbers occasionally started from 1001 instead of the expected sequence. The auto-number generator now produces a reliable, consistent sequence. N/A PROC-25839 Show Warning / Error If Two Properties Use the Same Label in the Same Entity BOL Editor now raises a warning when two properties within the same entity share an identical label, preventing ambiguity at runtime and improving data quality during schema design. User Guide: Data Studio- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-26051 Entity Creation via Excel Sheet: Support for Config VH Creation (s_status etc.) The Excel-based entity creation utility now supports creation of config-type value helps (e.g. s_status) in addition to regular entities, significantly reducing manual setup steps for new entities. User Guide: Data Studio- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-23549 Training: Incorrect Automatic Import When Typecasting Using Private Node Suggestion Fixed the code editor's auto-import logic when accepting a typecast suggestion from Private Node. The incorrect import statement is no longer inserted; the correct module path is used. N/A 3. Module: UI Editor / Wizard Below are the improvements and bug fixes delivered in this release for UI Editor and Notification Modeler. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24424 UI Editor Wizard: Integer/Decimal Column Headers and Cell Content Should Be Right-Aligned in Grid and Tree In the UI Editor Wizard, columns configured with Integer or Decimal property types now correctly right-align both header text and cell content in Grid and Tree screen types, matching standard numerical display conventions. Reference document : Page Builder- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-26821 Add Validation to Restrict Template ID Length to 25 Characters in Notification Modeler The Notification Modeler now enforces a maximum length of 25 characters for Template IDs at validation time, preventing downstream processing errors caused by oversized template identifiers. N/A 4. Module: kloReact / React Runtime Below are the bug fixes and improvements delivered in this release for the kloReact / React runtime, covering both web and mobile UI issues. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26727 kloReact APK/IPA: Notification Red Dot Not Removed After Marking All Notifications as Read Fixed a defect in kloReact APK and IPA builds where the notification red dot badge persisted even after all notifications were marked as read, causing confusion for mobile users. N/A PROC-26726 kloReact BOL Editor: Change Icon on VH Screen Does Not Open Icon Dialog Resolved a bug where clicking the 'Change' icon button on the VH (Value Help) screen in the BOL Editor under a kloReact environment did not open the icon picker dialog. N/A PROC-26725 kloReact: UI-Type VH Is Not Editable in Specific Scenario Fixed a scenario in kloReact where a Value Help of UI type was rendered as read-only when it should have been editable, preventing users from updating the VH value. N/A PROC-26719 kloReact: Upgrade Banner Click Throws Error as Alert Resolved an issue where clicking the upgrade banner in kloReact displayed a JavaScript error as a browser alert popup instead of handling it gracefully. N/A PROC-26718 kloReact: Menu Became Blank on Desktop During Parallel Mobile Testing with Same User Fixed a race condition in kloReact where the desktop menu became blank when the same user account was simultaneously active in a mobile session, caused by conflicting menu state updates. N/A PROC-26716 kloReact: Create Button Alignment and Checkbox Size Mismatch in User Collections Corrected a CSS mismatch between kloTouch and kloReact runtime in the User Collections screen — the Create button alignment and individual check/tick-box size are now consistent. N/A PROC-26714 kloReact: User Details Not Showing After Navigating to About Page Then Logging Out Fixed an issue where navigating to the About page and then logging out caused user details to be absent on the next login, due to stale session state not being cleared. N/A PROC-26713 kloReact: Incorrect Alignment on Login Page Corrected layout alignment issues on the kloReact login page, ensuring consistent positioning across screen sizes and device types. N/A PROC-26158 React Phase 01: SAP Icons Should Not Be Shown for React Flavors in Any Tool SAP-specific icon sets are no longer displayed in Dev Tools for React-type flavors, as SAP icons are not applicable to React runtime environments. N/A PROC-25987 React Phase 01: Delay Should Not Be Used for Loading kloTouch Files Removed artificial delays used when loading kloTouch files in the React runtime. Files are now loaded via a proper event-driven mechanism, improving startup performance and reliability. N/A PROC-21063 No Internet Connection Banner: UI Improvement Improved icons, responsiveness and alignment of No Internet Connection and Upgrade banners for better display across mobile and desktop resolutions. N/A PROC-23390 navByQuery Not Working in Mobile Application When Navigating with kloGuid Control Fixed a bug preventing navByQuery from functioning correctly on mobile applications when navigation was triggered via a kloGuid control, restoring expected deep-navigation behaviour. N/A 5. Module: BOL Node / Server / Middleware Below are the improvements and bug fixes delivered in this release for BOL Node 512 MB, server-side message processing, and middleware. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24595 BOL Node 512 MB: Middleware Message Dispatch Messages are now correctly excluded from dispatch to dedicated nodes and master node for processing when running in the 512 MB BOL Node configuration, preventing unnecessary processing overhead. N/A PROC-24592 BOL Node 512 MB: Server-Side Query Streaming (Rules / Scheduler / AppService) Implemented server-side query streaming for Rules, Scheduler, and AppService executions in the 512 MB BOL Node environment, enabling efficient processing of large result sets without memory overflow. N/A PROC-25937 Message Monitoring: Queries Need to Be Optimised Optimised the server queue monitor queries that were causing slowdowns due to 3.1 million records in the ma_tenant_log_q table. Indexes and query refactoring significantly reduce monitor execution time. N/A PROC-26584 More Than One Master Found: Service cacheMaster Fixed a parallel election race condition in middleware where multiple nodes started simultaneously and each declared itself master. The election protocol now correctly ensures a single master is elected. N/A 6. Module: Mobile (APK / IPA) Below are the bug fixes delivered in this release for the mobile APK and IPA builds. Note: an APK/IPA rebuild is required for PROC-24144. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24144 Unnecessary Permission Requests in APK for KloRemark and Document Upload Removed spurious permission prompts in the Android APK: KloRemark no longer requests microphone permission on screen load without user interaction, and Document Upload no longer triggers unnecessary storage permissions. Both now request permissions only at the point of use. APK/IPA rebuild required 7. Module: Account Console / Permissions / Notifications Below are the improvements delivered in this release for Account Console role management and push notifications. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26524 Enhancement: Enforce Default Permissions and Validation for New Roles At DEV Systems, after a new role creation, a warning box will be shown on the screen, to inform the developers about maintaining the permissions for that new role, to avoid Access Denied scenario for the respective users belonging to that role. Document: LINK . N/A PROC-25592 Push Notification: Improvements When a notification is clicked by a different user, the app shows a Switch User message with notification user details and switch information about switching accounts and possible unsaved data loss. If there are unsaved changes, an additional warning note is also displayed. Also, once the intended user logs back in, missed notifications can be reviewed anytime from the Notification Centre (🔔). Document: LINK . N/A 8. Module: Server-Side Pivot / Report / Chart Below are the new features delivered in this release for PIVOT, REPORT, and CHART screen types. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-25423 Phase 01 Runtime: Server-Side Pivoting for PIVOT / REPORT / CHART Screens Pivoting operations for PIVOT, REPORT, and CHART screen types are now executed server-side rather than on the client, significantly improving performance for large datasets and reducing browser memory usage. N/A 9. Module: Business AI Below are the new features delivered in this release for the Business AI module. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26816 Business AI: Application Workflow Context Implementation — POC and Phase 1 Completed POC and Phase 1 implementation of application workflow context for Business AI. The AI assistant can now understand and reason about the workflow state of the current application, enabling context-aware suggestions. N/A PROC-26745 Business AI: VH Query Suggestion Display to User Business AI now surfaces Value Help query suggestions to the user during data entry. When a VH Query field requires idata, the AI fires a query matching on key or description and presents the best matches for user selection. N/A 10. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-27362 OData BO Support – Deep Update (Header + Child updates in a single call) No BOL Extended OData support to allow deep update operations where both header and child entity data can be updated in a single API call. Previously, multi-level updates required sequential requests, increasing round trips. Clients can send nested JSON payloads containing parent entity properties along with child entity arrays. Child entities are automatically matched by parent key - existing children are updated, and new children are created.All operations are committed in a single transaction with full validation support. This significantly reduces overhead for complex entity hierarchies. Document Link Status: Tested PROC-27343 BOL Node 512 MB Stability Verification & Issue Resolution No BOL Verified stability of the BOL Node running under a 512 MB memory constraint and resolved all identified issues. Ensures the platform operates reliably within constrained memory environments for applicable deployments. Status: Done - Closed PROC-27366 Middleware: 1000 messages with no_sequence=0 took 17 minutes to process No BOL - Middleware Resolved a middleware throughput issue where 1000 messages with no_sequence=0 took 17 minutes to complete against only 1 minute of actual processing time (16 minutes idle). Queuing and dispatch logic has been optimized to eliminate idle wait between message batches. Status: Tested PROC-26465 Middleware: Default retry delay for deadlock/lock wait should be increased No BOL - Middleware For the middleware retry settings for Inbound Messages, the RetryDelaySeconds default value has been changed to 1 second in the config.json file. If it’s already overridden, then that value is not changed. Document Link Status: Tested PROC-25080 Transport log showing source and target landscape as "undefined" No BOL - Transport Fixed a transport logging defect where source and target landscape names appeared as "undefined" in the transport log. Landscape identifiers are now correctly resolved and displayed in all transport log entries. Status: Tested PROC-26541 Indexing required on Users Permissions table – madm_user_permissions No BOL Added a composite index on the r_user_id & r_landscape column in the madm_user_permissions table to improve query performance for user-based permission lookups. Status: Tested PROC-26503 Remove deprecated entity reference button or handle logic in BOL / BOL Editor No BOL / BOL Editor Removed the deprecated entity reference-based condition button from the BOL Editor UI. Updated the underlying logic to prevent duplicate condition generation and to ignore deprecated backward-compatibility paths, eliminating developer confusion caused by legacy UI artifacts. Status: Tested PROC-26994 Custom template should be enabled for OTP Services No BOL OTP notification services can now use custom message templates. Previously OTP messages were fixed to a system template. Developers can now configure custom templates for OTP emails and SMS channels, enabling branded OTP communications per application. Status: Tested Reference Document : Notification Developer Guide PROC-26106 Attachment: setAttachmentP() not working on server side No BOL Fixed a bug where setAttachmentP() called from server-side logic (entity callbacks or controllers) threw a "File Write Failed" error. The server-side attachment API now correctly processes and persists file data. Status: Tested PROC-25752 Phase 02 Runtime – PIVOT/REPORT/CHART: Server-side pivoting No BOL Implemented Phase 2 of server-side data pivoting. Pivot, Report, and Chart data transformations are now computed on the server instead of the client browser, reducing client-side load and significantly improving performance for large datasets. Status: Tested User Guide link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oNQqNsgTLLFqtPn7914ggasXzJTDXc-oSo6QBYq9T6Y/edit?tab=t.0 PROC-22355 API Versioning Behavior Creates Misleading User Experience No BOL Corrected API URL versioning behaviour that was ignoring explicitly requested patch versions and automatically redirecting to the latest patch. API version resolution now honours the requested version, giving developers predictable and accurate versioning. Status: Done - Closed PROC-25409 BOL Editor: Excel-uploaded entry not present after refreshing (Rollup status and Status Config) No BOL Editor Fixed a persistence bug in BOL Editor where entries added via Excel upload were not retained after a page refresh in the Rollup Status and Status Config views. Uploaded entries now correctly persist to the database and reload on refresh. Status: Tested PROC-24593 BOL Node 512 MB – OData GET Services No BOL Validated and ensured OData GET service functionality is fully operational in the BOL Node 512 MB memory configuration. Addressed compatibility issues specific to this constrained memory deployment scenario. Status: Tested PROC-25001 BOL/Metadata: adding vh to query parameter not updating query generation No BOL Fixed a metadata query generation bug where adding a value help (vh) to a query parameter did not correctly update the generated query. The query generator now correctly incorporates vh-based parameters, ensuring accurate data retrieval. Status: Tested PROC-24749 Training: get$Role() returning empty object {} in controller and console No BOL Resolved an issue where get$Role() returned {} instead of the user's role data when called from a controller. The function now correctly retrieves and returns the active user role, consistent with $SYSTEM.roleId behaviour. Status: Tested PROC-27146 Safeguards to prevent recursive invocation between entity callback and CommitP API No BOL Added runtime safeguards to detect and break recursive call loops that occur when an entity callback triggers a CommitP API call, which in turn re-invokes the entity callback. Prevents infinite recursion and stack overflow in server-side business logic. Validation added in case the same transaction is being used for commitP() from callbacks throwing error as “Transaction commit is already in progress. Please wait for the current commit to finish before calling commit again.“. e.g., Developers should not use commitP() by using the same transaction at the rules callbacks - get the transaction from oEvent (function parameter) and use that for commitP() later on in the rules callback. Document Link 1, Document Link 2 Status: Tested PROC-26611 SEAM4: error_code missing in kloerror when commitP fails No BOL Fixed a bug where the error_code field was absent in the kloerror response object when a commitP operation failed. The error_code is now correctly populated, enabling downstream error handling to distinguish and respond to specific failure types. Status: Tested

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-27409 Option to select wizard screen type, plus known issues fixes No KloTouch Added a UI Editor option to select the wizard screen type when creating screens. Previously this selection was only available via Developer AI. Also includes fixes for known issues in the wizard screen creation flow. Developers can now create wizard-type screens entirely from the UI Editor. Status: Tested PROC-26662 REL_26/15-18 HomePage Editor: KL0018 testcase failing, Navigation not working No KloTouch Fixed a navigation regression in the HomePage Editor where the KL0018 test case was failing due to broken navigation on the homepage screen. Navigation flows on homepage-type screens now behave correctly per the defined test specification. Status: Tested PROC-25246 Need busyIndicator while vh is loading data for F4 No KloTouch Added a busy indicator that displays while value help (vh) data is being fetched for F4 field searches. Previously the F4 popup gave no visual feedback during data load, creating confusion about system responsiveness. Status: Tested

Below are the list of new features/improvements developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-27164 Business AI – Application Context implementation Phase 2 No Business AI Completed Phase 2 of the Application Context feature for Business AI. This phase integrates kloQuery callbacks and additional AI context scenarios, enabling Business AI to generate queries and responses with richer, application-aware data. Status: Tested Reference Guide - Business_AI_User_Guide PROC-26607 Developer AI – User/App level token limits and usage metrics No Developer AI Implemented configurable token limit enforcement and usage tracking at user and application level for Developer AI. Administrators can now set per-user and per-app token quotas; usage metrics are tracked for governance and cost control. Status: Tested PROC-27240 Developer AI – All LLM calls properly logged in LangSmith No Developer AI All LLM calls from Developer AI are now captured in LangSmith with proper, searchable names. Previously generic entries made it impossible to isolate individual AI call chains. Each call now appears with a meaningful identifier. Status: Tested PROC-27215 Developer AI – Early return on dependency failure in agents No Developer AI Added early-exit logic across RuleAgent, SchedulerAgent, NotificationAgent, and SampleDataAgent. If any upstream dependency fails mid-execution, the agent immediately returns a clear error instead of continuing with partial or misleading output. Status: Tested PROC-26921 Developer AI – Code files fetched from actual repository No Developer AI Developer AI now fetches existing code files directly from the version-controlled source repository instead of the local file system, ensuring AI modifications are based on the live codebase rather than potentially stale copies. Status: Tested PROC-27598 Developer AI – Qdrant not supporting 3072 dimensions No Developer AI Fixed a vector storage compatibility issue where Qdrant rejected 3072-dimension embeddings. The Qdrant collection is now correctly configured to support the required dimensionality for the AI embedding model in use. Status: Tested PROC-27565 Developer AI – Incorrect accountId in payload causing metadata save error No Developer AI Corrected a payload bug where an incorrect accountId caused AI metadata save operations to fail. The payload now correctly resolves and includes the authenticated user's accountId before submission. Status: Tested PROC-27214 Developer AI – Run-only-jobs includes screen creation in response No Developer AI Fixed a response scoping issue where selecting "run only jobs" in Developer AI still returned screen creation results. The agent now correctly restricts execution and response to the selected job types only. Status: Tested PROC-27128 Developer AI – Errors in Google Cloud logs during normal operation No Developer AI Resolved error-level log entries in Google Cloud logs triggered by normal Developer AI operations. Log levels have been corrected and error handling improved to eliminate false-alarm log noise. Status: Tested PROC-27034 Developer AI – Handle transient fields in SampleDataAgent/RuleAgents/NotificationAgent No Developer AI Updated agents to correctly differentiate Regular, Transient, and Calculated property types. Previously transient fields were incorrectly included in insert operations, causing errors and invalid data generation. Status: Tested PROC-27024 Developer AI – getEntitiesDetails API returning all properties as Regular No Developer AI Fixed a logic bug where getEntitiesDetails returned all properties as "Regular" regardless of actual type. Property types are now correctly derived from entity configuration (Transient, Calculated, Regular). Status: Tested PROC-27021 Developer AI – Attachment and GeoLocation must be transient, not regular No Developer AI Corrected property type classification for Attachment and GeoLocation to Transient, as these are not persisted directly in the entity table. Ensures correct handling by all AI agents. Status: Tested PROC-26309 Developer AI – Clear message when requested App is not found No Developer AI Improved error handling so Developer AI returns a clear, actionable message when a requested application does not exist, instead of a generic failure. Status: Tested PROC-26281 Developer AI – Handle concurrent multi-user requests No Developer AI Implemented concurrency handling for simultaneous multi-user Developer AI requests. Each user's workflow now executes in full isolation, preventing session cross-contamination. Status: Tested PROC-26278 Developer AI – Use incremental IDs for screens, remove datekey No Developer AI Replaced timestamp-based datekeys in AI-generated screen IDs with deterministic incremental IDs. Added duplicate ID checks. Produces cleaner, predictable identifiers for AI-generated screens. Status: Tested PROC-26277 Developer AI – Multiple subscreen layouts incorrectly added to one subscreen No Developer AI Fixed a screen generation defect where multiple subscreen layout definitions were attached to the same subscreen. Each subscreen now receives only its designated layout. Status: Tested PROC-26271 Developer AI – Validate each metadata item created for screen No Developer AI Added per-metadata validation during AI screen generation. Each generated metadata item is individually validated before persistence, allowing errors to be caught granularly. Status: Tested PROC-25033 React Phase 01 – Playwright automation No React UI Implemented Playwright-based automated test coverage for React Phase 01 deliverables. Establishes a regression test baseline for the React UI track. Status: Tested

PROC-27570 Created saved query not available in VH No BOL Editor: Addressed an issue causing the Data Browser to fail to display data for value helps created from saved queries. PROC-27379 Attachment download: No error thrown when trying to download a attachment but is not downloading No BOL When trying to download attachment using downloadAttachP, If it fails to fetch the data or fails once For the next time if downloadAttachP is triggerd it does’t throw any error. This is due to the client side table gets the entry and for the next time the attachmentDownloadPromise stays as a unresolved promise and doesn’t throw any error Status: Tested. PROC-27170 Row auth :- Data access recalculation is failing No BOL Data Access Keys will also support for Entities having names in uppercase during search or recalculate operations in the screen under Access Management. Status: Tested. PROC-26700 Upgrade Cordova Projects to Android 15 and iOS 8 No Upgraded procifyapp-generic to cordova-android 15 (targetSdk 36) and cordova-ios 8 (SPM migration, new hooks, deprecated API fixes) — app version 3.2.12, backward compatible across iOS/Android/Desktop/Tablet with no known issues. Full details: Cordova_Upgrade_Guide_Android15_iOS8. PROC-26043 BOL VH:- vh is inherited from parent flavor even after deleting from child flavor No BOL Even after removing the value help (VH) in the child flavor It is still appearing in the UI. If VH is removed or overridden in the child flavor, there shouldn’t be any need to make changes in the parent flavors. Status: Done - Closed. PROC-26017 oData service : Missing confirmation for relational (child) data save in oData response No BOL When sending relational (child) data within the parent entity JSON, the oData response only returns the parent entity data. The response does not include any details or confirmation regarding whether the relational (child) data has been successfully saved. $expand and its relation names need to be maintained in the URL to show the relational entities data in the response. $expand is for response purpose only, it does not affect the update process. Explained this behavior in the document: ODATA SERVICES User Guide 6.0 - Important Point No. 6. Status: Not an Issue - Closed. PROC-25979 Production Excel Upload Error - Precison should be 2 No Updated the setter to automatically format/round the value based on the configured precision before storing it, ensuring that the value always conforms to the defined precision. Note: This change is applicable only to new entries. Existing entries will not be affected. If this change is required for existing entries, build will be required for the flavor. Status: Tested. PROC-25942 PVT Node: Folders are coming in new but throwing error while committing No BOL - Private Node PVT Node: Folders are coming in new but throwing error while committing. Status: Tested. PROC-25486 App Merge: Deleting a property deletes the config of the property but modifying only the property is not considering the config. No BOL When merging a branch to a version. If in version, a property is deleted(which had a config) and the same property is modified in branch and then merged, the property’s conflict gets resolved via app merge but the property’s config is not considered. Status: Tested. PROC-25447 Transport tool update is not completing in a single trigger. No BOL - Transport The update is not completing through the screen, and even though the tool update is automated via the terminal It remains in **in_progress** status. Status: Tested. PROC-25129 App Merge : during merge of newly created app_service the system fields are not filled for app service file in m_file. No BOL Fixed an App Merge defect where system fields were not populated for a newly created app_service entry in m_file during merge, which caused issues in private node checkout when validating s_modified_on. Status: Tested. PROC-23429 Relation Data not shown when creating parent's data No BOL Fixed a defect where related child data was not displayed while creating a parent record. Status: Tested.

Status: Tested. PROC-26470 getSelectedIndices() returns an empty array when called on a transnode used inside a dialog, as dialog sections are not included in active node filtering. No KloTouch When `getSelectedIndices()` is called on a transnode used within a dialog It returns an empty array. This occurs because the current implementation filters sections only from the screen’s active nodes, excluding sections rendered inside dialogs. Status: Tested. PROC-26174 Separate Key and Description Columns for Selected Properties in Excel Download No The vhDownloadFormat property lets developers configure how individual Value Help (VH) fields are exported during the standard Excel download by specifying key, description, or key + description for each VH field (for example: [{"my_key":"key"},{"country_code":"desc"},{"state_code":"key-desc"}]). Only the VH fields listed in this property follow the configured format, while all other VH fields use the default download behavior. If a non-VH field is included in the property, the download continues with the normal field value without errors, although a console warning/error may be logged. This configuration applies only to the standard Excel Download button and does not affect the ShowDownloadExcelOptions button, which already allows users to choose the VH export format for all column KloSectionXLSX. Developer Level 2 — Advanced Track Enhancing the Customer Complaints Application This track does not build a new application. Every session goes back into the SAME Customer Complaints app built in Developer Level 1, and layers a new advanced capability onto it — the same end-to-end build approach used in the Level 1 guide. Prerequisite: Developer Level 1 completion is mandatory. Proposed dates are placeholders (one session per working day, starting Mon 07 Sep 2026) — confirm actual start date and cadence.

Developer Level 1 was built as an end-to-end project: one real application — the Customer Complaints Application — built up session by session. This Level 2 guide follows the same approach: no new application is created. Every session below re-opens the entities, pages, entity files, and controllers already built in Level 1 and extends them with an advanced capability, so trainees see how real applications evolve rather than practicing features in isolation. Topics are drawn from the Training Topics sheet, filtered to entries tagged “Developer Level 2,” and mapped onto concrete enhancements of the existing app. Tool names use the current naming glossary, with legacy names noted where relevant.

Sessions must be taken in order — each session's steps assume the previous session's enhancement is already in place, exactly as in the Level 1 guide. Session Date Topic Area Application Enhancement Session 1 Mon, 07 Sep 2026 Advanced BOL & Data Modelling Network Modes — Offline-Ready Properties · Sort Order & Entity Index · Entity Rules — Auto-Escalation on Update · Query Rules — Role-Based Field Masking · BOL Transaction — Close Complaint with Feedback Session 2 Tue, 08 Sep 2026 Advanced Page Builder & Client-Side Debugging Embedded Section — Complaint Timeline · Advanced kloControls · TransNode onArrive & navigateId · Server-Side Debugging & Auto Update Data Session 3 Wed, 09 Sep 2026 Security, Permissions & Data Access Design-Time Permissions · Row Wise Auth · Data Access Rules & User Access Summary · Role Permissions (Runtime) & Permission Logs Session 4 Thu, 10 Sep 2026 Offline, Middleware & Bulk Data Local Archive · Initial Downloads · Middleware — Device & SAP · KloSectionXlsx — Bulk Customer Import Session 5 Fri, 11 Sep 2026 Workflows, Scheduling & Notifications Escalation Approval Workflow · Scheduler — Nightly SLA Sweep · Notifications · deeplink & Banner Session 6 Mon, 14 Sep 2026 Reporting — Charts & Pivot Modeller kloChart — Status Breakdown · Advanced Chart — TAT Trend · Pivot Modeller Session 7 Tue, 15 Sep 2026 Monitoring & Troubleshooting Scheduler & Log Monitoring · Notification & Queue Monitoring · APK/IPA & Query Console Session 8 Wed, 16 Sep 2026 App Management, Branding & Deployment App Inheritance & Modification · Customer Branding · Git Repo & Active Sessions · App Migration to QA

Configure Network Modes so offline-relevant properties sync correctly to field devices. Apply Sort Order and an Entity Index to d_complaints for performance and predictable ordering. Extend the existing Entity Rules with a new auto-escalation rule. Extend the existing Query Rules with role-based field masking. Build a BOL Transaction that commits two entities atomically. What This Session Builds On Developer Level 1 (Sessions 1–5) built d_complaints with its properties, one Entity Rule (onCreateComplaint) and one Query Rule (beforeQ) on q_complaints. This session does not start a new entity — it goes back into the same d_complaints and q_complaints files and adds the advanced BOL capabilities on top.

A field IT Team member on a tablet needs complaint status and priority visible even with no signal, while internal notes stay server-side only. Meanwhile complaints are quietly sailing past SLA with no auto-flag, and a support rep spots that anyone on the IT Team can see a customer's full contact details in the list — details they never needed for their job.

Not every property should sync to a field device the same way. Configure Network Mode per property on d_complaints. # Action Detail 1 Open properties Procify Data Studio → d_complaints → Properties tab. 2 Restrict remark Set Network Mode = Online Only on remark — internal notes should not be cached on IT Team field devices. 3 Always sync core fields Set Network Mode = Always on complaint_id, s_status, priority so they remain visible even when the device is offline. 4 Save & update schema Save, then Update Schema, and confirm no errors.
documents.s: Part A — Network Modes — Offline-Ready Properties

documents.t: The complaints list currently has no defined default order and no index for the fields it is filtered on most. # Action Detail 1 Set Sort Order On priority: custom order CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW. On created_on: DESCENDING as the secondary sort. 2 Create Entity Index Entity Index tab → Add → ID: idx_complaint_status_priority — fields: s_status, priority. 3 Update Schema Update Schema and verify the index is listed under the entity's Test → Data Browser diagnostics.
documents.s: Part B — Sort Order & Entity Index

documents.t: Reopen the same d_complaints.ts file from Level 1 Session 5 and add a second rule alongside onCreateComplaint. # Action Detail 1 Register the rule Rule tab → Add → Event Type: On Update | Channel: Always on Server | Clazz: this | Invocation Method: checkEscalation. 2 Implement checkEscalation If s_status is OPEN or INPROCESS and (today − created_on) > 3 days, set is_escalated = true. 3 Test Backdate a test record's created_on in Data Browser to 4 days ago, save, and confirm is_escalated flips to true.
documents.s: Part C — Entity Rules — Auto-Escalation on Update

documents.t: Extend q_complaints.ts — the same file where beforeQ was written in Level 1 Session 4 — with an afterQ rule. # Action Detail 1 Add afterQ Event Type: After Query. In the handler, if the requesting role is IT_TEAM, replace customer contact fields in each result row with ‘•••’. 2 Test as IT Team Log in as it_<prid> — confirm customer contact fields are masked in the list. 3 Test as Manager Log in as mgr_<prid> — confirm the same fields show full data.
documents.s: Part D — Query Rules — Role-Based Field Masking

documents.t: Combine a status update and a new voice record into one atomic operation. # Action Detail 1 Create the transaction Data Studio → new BOL Transaction Tx_CloseWithFeedback, covering d_complaints (update s_status = CLOSED) and d_complaint_voices (create feedback record). 2 Wire the button Add a ‘Close with Feedback’ action on s_detail_header that commits both TransNodes through this transaction. 3 Test atomicity Force the voice record to fail validation (e.g. leave it blank) and confirm the status change also rolls back — not just the voice record. Session 1 Checkpoint ✔ Network Modes verified in an offline emulation for at least 3 properties. ✔ s_complaints defaults to priority order; idx_complaint_status_priority exists and is used. ✔ checkEscalation rule fires correctly on a backdated test record. ✔ afterQ masks customer fields for IT_TEAM but not for Manager. ✔ Tx_CloseWithFeedback commits both entities together or rolls back together. Enhancement delivered: Extends the existing d_complaints / q_complaints files from Level 1 (not a new entity) with offline sync control, performance indexing, automatic SLA escalation, field-level data masking by role, and an atomic close-with-feedback commit.
documents.s: Part E — BOL Transaction — Close Complaint with Feedback

documents.t: Build a reusable Embedded Section and use it on two different pages. Add Advanced kloControls (rating, file uploader) to the detail screen. Configure TransNode onArrive and navigateId behaviour. Debug the Session 1 server-side rule using Server-Side Debugging. Enable Auto Update Data so the Manager's list refreshes without manual action. What This Session Builds On p_complaints was built manually in Level 1 Session 2 and styled in Session 6; p_complaint_dashboard was built in Session 5. Both existing pages are extended here — no new page is created from scratch.

A Manager opens a complaint and has to hunt across screens to see whether this customer has complained before. A rep marks a complaint resolved but there's no way to capture how satisfied the customer actually was, or attach a photo of a damaged product without emailing it separately.

Build one timeline section and reuse it in two places. # Action Detail 1 Create the section New section s_complaint_timeline (screenType: timeline) bound to a TransNode combining voices and status-change history. 2 Embed in detail In pa_comp_details, add a new section, mark it Embedded, and point its source to s_complaint_timeline. 3 Reuse on dashboard Add the same embedded section to p_complaint_dashboard as a ‘Recent Activity’ panel — confirming true cross-page reuse.
documents.s: Part A — Embedded Section — Complaint Timeline

documents.t: Add two controls that were not covered in Level 1's basic control set. # Action Detail 1 Add kloRating On s_detail_header, add a kloRating control bound to a new transient property t_satisfaction_score, visible only when s_status = CLOSED. 2 Add kloFileUploader On the attachments section, add kloFileUploader bound to the d_complaints_attachment relation built in Level 1. 3 Full Preview Confirm the rating control only appears on closed complaints and the uploader stores a file record correctly.

Make the detail screen smarter about what loads automatically and where links resolve to. # Action Detail 1 Configure onArrive On the detail TransNode, set onArrive to auto-load the 5 most recent related voices — no extra click required. 2 Configure navigateId On the ticket_id link control, set navigateId so it always resolves to pa_complaint_details, whether clicked from p_complaints or the dashboard's embedded timeline. 3 Test both entry points Click a complaint from the main list, then from the dashboard timeline — confirm both land on the same detail area correctly populated.

Debug the rule written in Session 1 and make the Manager's grid self-refreshing. # Action Detail 1 Attach debugger Set a breakpoint inside checkEscalation in VS Code and attach to the running Private Node. 2 Step through Trigger a save on a test complaint and step through the rule execution line by line. 3 Enable auto refresh On s_complaints, set Auto Update Data = true with a 30-second interval. 4 Verify Create a complaint as Employee in one browser tab; confirm it appears in the Manager's grid within 30 seconds without a manual refresh. Session 2 Checkpoint ✔ s_complaint_timeline renders correctly on both p_complaints and p_complaint_dashboard. ✔ kloRating and kloFileUploader function as specified. ✔ onArrive auto-loads voices; navigateId resolves correctly from both entry points. ✔ Breakpoint debugging confirmed inside checkEscalation. ✔ Manager's grid auto-refreshes within 30 seconds of a new complaint being created. Enhancement delivered: Adds a reusable complaint-history timeline, a satisfaction rating and attachment capture on resolution, smarter auto-loading/navigation, and a self-refreshing Manager grid — all on the existing pages built in Level 1.
documents.s: Part D — Server-Side Debugging & Auto Update Data

documents.t: Enforce CRUD restrictions server-side using design-time Permissions. Restrict IT Team visibility to their own team's complaints using Row Wise Auth. Scope customer data by region using Data Access Rules. Audit a user's effective access using User Access Summary. Grant, use, and revoke a temporary elevated Role Permission, and confirm it in Permission Logs. What This Session Builds On Level 1 Session 7 hid or disabled buttons per role using Vienable — a UI-level control only. This session enforces the same rules at the platform/security level so they hold even if a user calls the API directly.

An IT Team member who left last month still has delete rights if they call the API directly, even though the button is hidden in the UI. A regional manager can see every customer's complaints nationwide instead of just their region, and after an override was granted during an incident, nobody can say who approved it or when it was revoked.

Configure real CRUD restrictions, not just hidden buttons. # Action Detail 1 Configure Employee Employee role: Create + Read only. 2 Configure Manager Manager role: Create + Read + Update + Delete. 3 Configure IT Team IT Team role: Read + Update only. 4 Test server-side block Log in as emp_<prid> and confirm Delete is blocked even if attempted outside the hidden button (e.g. via a direct API call).

Restrict IT Team to only the complaints assigned to their own team. # Action Detail 1 Configure the rule Row Wise Auth on d_complaints: IT_TEAM role only receives rows where responsible_team = current user's team. 2 Test Log in as it_<prid> — confirm only assigned complaints appear, even via direct navigation to a different complaint's URL.

Scope customer master data regionally and verify it. # Action Detail 1 Create the rule New Data Access Rule scoping d_customers by region. 2 Assign to Manager Assign the rule to mgr_<prid> for their region. 3 Verify with User Access Summary Open User Access Summary for mgr_<prid> and confirm the rule and effective permissions are listed correctly.
documents.s: Part C — Data Access Rules & User Access Summary

documents.t: Simulate an incident requiring temporary elevated access, then audit it. # Action Detail 1 Grant temporary access Create a runtime Role Permission override allowing IT_TEAM_LEAD to Delete during an incident. 2 Use and revoke Apply, test the elevated Delete, then revoke the override. 3 Audit in Permission Logs Confirm both the grant and the revoke appear in Permission Logs with timestamp and actor. Session 3 Checkpoint ✔ CRUD restrictions enforced server-side for all 3 roles. ✔ IT Team row-level filtering confirmed, including via direct URL access. ✔ Data Access Rule created, assigned, and confirmed via User Access Summary. ✔ Temporary Role Permission granted, used, revoked, and fully audited in Permission Logs. Enhancement delivered: Replaces Level 1's UI-only button hiding (Vienable) with rules enforced at the platform/security level, restricts IT Team visibility to assigned complaints, scopes customer data by region, and closes the audit gap on temporary access.
documents.s: Part D — Role Permissions (Runtime) & Permission Logs

documents.t: Enable offline access to assigned complaints for field IT Team users via Local Archive. Reduce first-login sync payload using Initial Downloads. Push closed complaints to an external SAP system via Middleware. Bulk-import customer master data using KloSectionXlsx. What This Session Builds On The application has only worked online through Sessions 1–3. This session makes it usable by IT Team members working onsite without connectivity, and adds a bulk-data path for customer onboarding.

An IT Team technician visiting a customer site with no signal can't pull up the complaint they're there to resolve. Every login re-downloads the full complaint history instead of just what's assigned, closed complaints aren't reaching the SAP billing system automatically, and onboarding 20 new customers means entering each one by hand.

Keep a working slice of data on the device for offline use. # Action Detail 1 Configure archive scope Local Archive on d_complaints and d_complaint_voices for the IT_TEAM role — retain the last 30 days of assigned complaints on-device. 2 Test offline On a device/emulator, disconnect network and confirm assigned complaints and their voice history are still viewable.

Reduce what gets pulled on first login. # Action Detail 1 Configure the download set Only OPEN/INPROCESS complaints assigned to the logging-in IT Team user are included in the first sync — not full history. 2 Verify Time a fresh login before and after the change and confirm a smaller payload.

Integrate with an external billing system. # Action Detail 1 Configure the channel New Middleware channel that pushes CLOSED complaints to an external SAP endpoint for billing reconciliation. 2 Test Close a test complaint and confirm the outbound payload appears in the middleware queue.

Add Excel-based bulk operations to the customer master entity. # Action Detail 1 Add to d_customers Attach KloSectionXlsx to the customer section, enabling bulk Excel upload/download. 2 Bulk import Prepare a sample sheet of 20 customers and import via the section. 3 Verify Confirm all 20 records land correctly in Data Browser. Session 4 Checkpoint ✔ IT Team can view assigned complaints and voice history fully offline. ✔ Initial download payload measurably reduced and verified. ✔ One closed complaint confirmed pushed to the SAP middleware queue. ✔ 20 customers successfully bulk-imported via KloSectionXlsx. Enhancement delivered: Makes the app usable in the field without connectivity, shrinks the first-login sync payload, automates the SAP billing hand-off on closure, and adds bulk customer onboarding.
documents.s: Part D — KloSectionXlsx — Bulk Customer Import

documents.t: Route escalated complaints through a Manager approval Workflow. Add a nightly Scheduled Task as a server-side safety net for SLA breaches. Notify the right people by Email, SMS, and In-App at the right moments. Deep-link notification emails directly into the relevant complaint. Configure an app-wide Banner for planned maintenance. What This Session Builds On Session 1 added a server-side is_escalated flag. This session adds the human workflow and communication layer that reacts to it.

A complaint sits open for a week past SLA with no one following up, because there's no approval step and no nightly check catching it. A customer is never told their complaint was resolved unless someone remembers to call, and a support email can't deep-link straight to the complaint it's about.

Give escalation a human decision point. # Action Detail 1 Build the workflow When is_escalated becomes true, route an approval task to the Manager to confirm reassignment of responsible_team. 2 Test Trigger escalation on a test complaint and confirm the Manager receives the task in Pending Approvals.

Add a server-side safety net independent of individual saves. # Action Detail 1 Create the task Scheduled Task that runs nightly, re-checking all OPEN/INPROCESS complaints against the 3-day SLA rule from Session 1. 2 Run manually and verify Trigger once via Running Tasks and confirm overdue complaints are correctly flagged.
documents.s: Part B — Scheduler — Nightly SLA Sweep

documents.t: Close the communication loop for assignment and resolution. # Action Detail 1 Assignment email Email notification to responsible_team the moment a complaint is assigned. 2 Resolution in-app alert In-App notification to the originating Employee when status changes to CLOSED. 3 Verify delivery Trigger both scenarios and confirm delivery in Notification History.

Make notifications actionable and announce planned downtime. # Action Detail 1 Configure deeplink The assignment email's ‘View Complaint’ link opens directly to the correct complaint detail screen. 2 Configure Banner App-wide banner announcing a planned maintenance window, visible to all roles for 24 hours. Session 5 Checkpoint ✔ Escalation approval task correctly routed to and actionable by the Manager. ✔ Nightly scheduler flags overdue complaints on a manual run. ✔ Assignment email and resolution in-app alert both confirmed delivered in Notification History. ✔ Deeplink opens the exact correct complaint; banner visible to all 3 roles. Enhancement delivered: Adds a human approval step on escalation, a nightly check independent of individual saves, closes the communication loop on assignment/resolution, and makes notifications actionable.

Replace static dashboard tiles with a live kloChart. Build an advanced TAT trend chart over a rolling 30-day window. Build a Pivot Modeller report for cross-team, cross-type analysis. What This Session Builds On Level 1 Session 5 built p_complaint_dashboard with static status-count tiles fed by status_count_query. This session replaces and extends those same tiles with real charts.

A Manager glances at the dashboard and sees numbers that were already stale this morning, with no way to see the SLA trend over the last month or drill into which team is falling behind — only static totals.

Turn the existing tile counts into a live chart. # Action Detail 1 Add the chart Add a kloChart bar chart to p_complaint_dashboard bound to the existing status_count_query TransNode. 2 Cross-check and replace Verify the chart's counts match the old static tiles, then remove the tiles.

Add a second, more advanced chart tracking service-level performance. # Action Detail 1 Build the query New query aggregating actual_tat vs standard_tat by week for the last 30 days. 2 Configure the chart Advanced line chart with two series (actual vs standard) and custom axis formatting.
documents.s: Part B — Advanced Chart — TAT Trend

documents.t: Give Managers a drillable cross-tab report. # Action Detail 1 Build the pivot Rows = complaint_type, Columns = responsible_team, Values = count of complaints, Filter = current month. 2 Publish & verify Publish to the EAM Portal and confirm a Manager can drill into a specific cell to see the underlying records. Session 6 Checkpoint ✔ Static dashboard tiles fully replaced by a live kloChart with matching counts. ✔ TAT trend chart renders 30 days of actual-vs-standard data. ✔ Pivot report published to EAM Portal and drill-down verified. Enhancement delivered: Replaces static dashboard tiles with live, trend-aware reporting and adds a drillable cross-tab view for Managers.

Diagnose a simulated scheduler failure end-to-end using platform monitoring tools. Confirm notification delivery and resolve a stuck offline sync record. Confirm the SAP middleware payload was processed via Legacy Queue Monitoring. Trace a native control rendering issue on a built APK. Independently verify dashboard numbers using Query Console. What This Session Builds On The app is feature-complete after Sessions 1–6 (automation, offline sync, integrations, reporting). This session is entirely about operating and troubleshooting what was built, not adding new features.

The nightly SLA sweep silently failed last night and nobody noticed until complaints started piling up unflagged. A customer insists they never got a resolution notification, and there's no way to check; finance says a closed complaint never showed up in SAP and nobody can tell whether it's stuck or lost.

Break the Session 5 scheduler on purpose, then find and fix it. # Action Detail 1 Simulate a failure Introduce a bad condition into the nightly SLA-sweep task and trigger it. 2 Observe the failure Confirm the failure appears in Scheduler Monitoring and Task History. 3 Trace the root cause Find the underlying error in Google Logs. 4 Fix and re-run Correct the task and confirm success via Running Tasks.

Confirm the Session 4 and 5 integrations are actually working end-to-end. # Action Detail 1 Verify notifications Check Notification History for the assignment/resolution messages from Session 5 — confirm delivered status. 2 Diagnose a stuck sync Simulate a stuck offline record on Server Queue / Mobile Sync Queue for an IT Team device from Session 4, and resolve it. 3 Check the SAP channel Review Legacy Queue Monitoring to confirm the Session 4 closed-complaint payload to SAP was processed.

Trace a native rendering issue and cross-verify reporting data. # Action Detail 1 Build and test the APK Build a debug APK including the kloRating control from Session 2. 2 Debug if needed If the control fails to render natively, use APK/IPA debugging tools to trace the issue. 3 Cross-verify dashboard data Use Query Console to independently confirm the raw row counts behind the Session 6 dashboard charts. Session 7 Checkpoint ✔ Simulated scheduler failure diagnosed via Scheduler Monitoring + Google Logs and resolved. ✔ Notification delivery confirmed; one stuck sync record identified and resolved. ✔ SAP payload confirmed processed in Legacy Queue Monitoring. ✔ APK rendering issue for kloRating traced (fixed or root-caused). ✔ Dashboard chart numbers cross-verified against raw data via Query Console. Enhancement delivered: Shifts the training from building features to operating and troubleshooting everything Sessions 1–6 put in place.

Create a client-specific child flavor using App Inheritance. Customize the child flavor without touching the base app via App Modification. Apply Customer Branding to the login page, menus, and headers. Version-control all Level 2 code in a Git repo. Migrate the fully enhanced application to QA and confirm every enhancement survived. What This Session Builds On The base Customer Complaints app is now feature-rich after Sessions 1–7. This final session prepares it for a real client rollout — a branded, inherited child flavor, migrated to QA.

The business is onboarding a new client, Acme, who needs their own complaint categories and branded login screen without touching the shared base app every other client depends on. Before go-live, someone has to confirm a departed developer's session is revoked and that the whole app still works correctly once it's moved to QA.

Create a client-specific variant without duplicating the whole app. # Action Detail 1 Create the child flavor New flavor customer_complaints_acme_<prid> inheriting from the base application. 2 Override safely Use App Modification to override complaint_type values for Acme's business categories, without changing the base flavor.

Make the child flavor visually distinct. # Action Detail 1 Update login/registration Modify the index file for the Acme child flavor with Acme's logo and welcome text. 2 Apply CSS Style menus and headers to match Acme's brand colors, scoped to .procify__customer_complaints_acme_<prid>.

Clean up before go-live. # Action Detail 1 Push code to Git Push all entity rules, controller code, and CSS written across Sessions 1–8 into a Git repo. 2 Review sessions Check Active Sessions for the app and revoke any stale developer sessions before go-live.
documents.s: Part C — Git Repo & Active Sessions

documents.t: Ship the enhanced application and prove every feature survived the move. # Action Detail 1 Release the flavor Release the Acme child flavor. 2 Migrate Run App Migration (Transport) from DEV to QA. 3 Full smoke test On QA, verify: escalation rule (S1), embedded timeline (S2), permissions/row-level auth (S3), offline sync (S4), workflow + notifications (S5), dashboard charts (S6), and Acme branding (S8) all work correctly. Session 8 Checkpoint ✔ Acme child flavor created, visually distinct, and functionally overridden without touching the base app. ✔ All Level 2 code version-controlled in Git. ✔ Stale developer sessions reviewed and revoked. ✔ Application migrated to QA with every Session 1–8 enhancement verified working end-to-end. Enhancement delivered: Delivers a branded, client-specific flavor without touching the shared base app, and proves every Session 1–8 enhancement survives the move to QA.
documents.s: Part D — App Migration to QA
